connector.name: Airtable by domdomegg
connector.registryDescription: Read and write access to Airtable database schemas, tables, and records.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package airtable-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the domdomegg account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: AIRTABLE_API_KEY
env.description: Airtable personal access token (e.g., pat123.abc123). Create at https://airtable.com/create/tokens/new with scopes: schema.bases:read, data.records:read, and optionally schema.bases:write and data.records:write.
